# Songbird Immigration Consultants

> Songbird Immigration Consultants (Songbird Consultancy) is a UAE-licensed immigration and multi-service advisory firm helping individuals, families, investors, and businesses with visas, residency, citizenship, and global mobility. Head office in Ajman, UAE, with desks in Sharjah, Fujairah, Colombo, and Mumbai.

## About

- Motto: "One Firm. Every Path."
- UAE-licensed; 15+ years of global migration practice.
- Destinations served: UAE, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Europe, and the United States.
- Categories: Student, Visit, Work, Temporary Residence (TR), Permanent Residence (PR), Business/Investor, and Citizenship.
- Beyond immigration: business setup, patent & IP, maritime, HR, management, commercial brokering, concierge, and lifestyle services.

## Services

- [Immigration](https://songbird.ae/services/immigration/): Global immigration across the UAE, UK, USA, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, and Asia — study, visit, work, business, residency, and citizenship pathways.
- [Patent & IP Advisory](https://songbird.ae/services/patent-ip/): Protect trademarks, patents, and creative works across the UAE, GCC, and international jurisdictions.
- [Maritime Advisory](https://songbird.ae/services/maritime/): Vessel registration, flag-state compliance, and maritime company formation.
- [Management Advisory](https://songbird.ae/services/management/): Market entry, restructuring, governance, and growth consulting in the UAE.
- [HR Advisory](https://songbird.ae/services/hr/): UAE labour-law compliance, contracts, compensation, and recruitment.
- [Commercial Brokering](https://songbird.ae/services/commercial-brokering/): Business sales, commercial real estate, and investment introductions.
- [Concierge Services](https://songbird.ae/services/concierge/): Government transactions, property, schooling, and everyday support in the UAE.
- [Lifestyle Development](https://songbird.ae/services/lifestyle-development/): Education, wellness, culture, and expat integration.
- [Reservations & Hospitality](https://songbird.ae/services/reservations/): Priority access to dining, hotels, and experiences.
